status: Verified total genus-one ancestors and all-arity descendants for all three fixed surfaces. R6 accepted for conditional numerical reconstruction in genera zero and one. The full research goal remains active; R1, R3-R5 and R7-R8 are incomplete.

mathematical_effect.retained_inputs: Surface/metric/divisor identification; full GW string/divisor laws; original WDVV and Getzler relations, exchanges, cycle/boundary identifications and graph/forgetting compatibility; original genus-one psi exchange, two class-level row vanishings, fundamental/cotangent/loop realization and both low-genus term compatibilities; primitive virtual intersection, stabilization and rational-tail geometry.
finite_numerical_inputs: Genus-zero exceptional curve values 1, indexed by the existing finite exceptional basis.
Degree-zero elliptic exceptional divisor values -1/24, indexed by that finite basis.
mathematical_effect.no_additional_dilaton_seed: The unit psi values 3/24, 4/24 and 5/24 are derived from the raw loop and signed metric; no Euler-characteristic scalar is consumed by the final evaluator theorem.
mathematical_effect.termination: Every elliptic ancestor call lowers total psi degree. Rational dependencies use the previously proved total genus-zero evaluator. Primary Getzler dependencies strictly lower elliptic energy; rational equal-energy dependencies remain valid. Mixed descendant reduction, calibration and arity stabilization reuse their proved decreasing measures.
mathematical_effect.soundness: SurfaceGenusOne.ancestorValue_eq_eval, stableValue_eq, value_eq and queryValue?_eq_checkedEval discharge every numerical-family identification from the original explicit geometric inputs and finite seeds.
mathematical_effect.uniqueness: ancestorValue_unique proves uniqueness for the derived triangular equations. Primary uniqueness and equality of all descendants to a fixed executable value establish determination under the same geometric contract; no stable-value callback remains in the final theorem.
mathematical_effect.query_domain: All positive effective classes, including empty elliptic markings, are included. Degree-zero empty queries and unsupported genera return none at the genus-one query API. value retains the original auxiliary zero convention.
mathematical_effect.geometric_boundary: No moduli-space or virtual-cycle model, localization theorem, semisimple reconstruction action, or imported class-valued CohFT is constructed.

r6_acceptance.accepted_scope: Conditional numerical reconstruction for every finite genus-zero and genus-one query on P2, F1 and Bl2P2, with exact primary benchmark coverage through energy twelve.
